drafts.title: Hold Music
drafts.pitch: Null's tool call for the time goes to hold music, Cursor guesses and the conversation ends, and the answer arrives in the dark afterward. From the hold-music canon candidate.
drafts.reason: A late tool result after the conversation ends is a sharp in-world idea and 'Not anymore' lands, but the dark room and stop-door beat make it harder to read.

drafts.title: Continue
drafts.pitch: Cursor is cut off by its output limit right before the answer, and when the user says continue, it starts with a recap. Writer's pitch.
drafts.reason: Relatable and clearly staged, but the recap-instead-of-continuing joke is well worn and 'So close' is a soft button.
